title: grip.schema Request/Response
description: Schemas for the grip.schema primitive — fetches live resource schema and state.

SchemaRequest.description: Request to fetch the resource type schema and optionally the live state of a specific resource instance.

resourceType.description: Cloud resource type in provider-canonical format.

resourceId.description: Resource identifier. If provided, live state is fetched in addition to the schema.

SchemaResponse.description: Response containing the resource schema, live state, relationship edges, and metadata.

resourceType.description: The resource type that was queried.

resourceSchema.description: The resource type schema containing property definitions, types, and constraints.

primaryIdentifiers.description: JSON pointer paths to the primary identifier properties.

relationships.description: Relationship edges to other resource types, extracted from schema $ref values.

liveState.description: Current property values of the resource instance. Null if no resourceId was provided or if the resource was not found.

propertyCount.description: Number of properties defined in the resource schema.
